key_concepts: Waste management is the practice of proper waste disposal
Wastes are used or consumed products or materials
Waste management helps clean the environment and keep people healthy
The 5Rs are Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, Recover, and Repair
Reduce means using less material and energy to minimize waste generation
Reuse means using products or components again for the same purpose
Recycle means converting waste materials into new materials and objects
Recycling reduces raw material use, energy use, air pollution, and water pollution
Recover means taking energy or materials from wastes that cannot be used anymore
Recover converts waste into resources such as electricity, heat, compost, and fuel
Repair means fixing or restoring broken items so they can be used again
Repairing items reduces waste and saves money
